description: This file contains utility functions and initialization logic for managing sessions within a VSCode extension, including environment checks, session setup, and API interactions.

methods.name: kilo_isCli
methods.description: Checks if the environment variable KILO_CLI_MODE is set to 'true'.

methods.name: kilo_execIfExtension
methods.description: Executes a callback if not in CLI mode, returning a promise.

methods.name: kilo_initializeSessionManager
methods.description: Initializes a session manager with provided parameters, setting up environment-specific configurations and logging.
